brief.objective: Minimize closest_Lady_distance^2 + 1e6/(closest_Guard_distance + 0.1) within 240 s. Bandit starts 2600 m behind the Lady on the same orbit. The advanced Guard sits 600 m behind the Lady, directly in our path. Get as close to the Lady as possible (ideally a 5 m capture) while never letting the Guard inside roughly 250-300 m.
brief.approach: Do not fly straight down the along-track line into the Guard. Open early with a radial-inward (-x) sidestep of several hundred metres combined with forward thrust. Lower orbit drifts us forward along +y for free, so the flank pass costs less fuel and gives the Guard a crossing geometry instead of a head-on intercept. Use EVADE_GUARD whenever the Guard is inside 400 m and closing faster than about 5 m/s, always sidestepping toward the Lady rather than retreating; return to APPROACH_LADY once the Guard is behind us or opening. Cap closing speed so we can still brake within the remaining range. Spend the last 30-40 s on the final glide slope to the Lady, accepting a slightly larger miss rather than a Guard pass under 150 m.
phases: 0-20 s: GO_TO_WAYPOINT about (-400, -1800) to flank the Guard radially inward while building along-track speed toward the Lady
20-120 s: Flank pass: APPROACH_LADY at up to 15 m/s along the offset track, with EVADE_GUARD triggered inside 400 m when the Guard is closing, keeping the Guard on our outer/aft side
120-200 s: Once past the Guard, APPROACH_LADY on a braking glide slope; keep the Lady between us and the Guard where possible
200-240 s: Final approach at 2 m/s or less to reach 5 m; use BRAKE if overshooting. Use HOLD_STANDOFF only if the Guard threatens inside 150 m and there is no evasion line toward the Lady
Throughout: COAST whenever the trajectory is already good, to preserve the 15% fuel reserve for late evasion
